{{Top|leg}}
'''Food analyzers''' were specialized [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that were capable of scanning and analyzing [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]]. [[SuriTech Foodstuffs]] manufactured a personal food analyzer, the [[Ez1 Analyzer]], while [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica's]] [[434-FPC Personal Chef Droid]] was equipped with a [[Food Sample Analyzer]] as standard.
